name: How long does a typical tile flooring installation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical tile flooring installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tile flooring installation varies significantly based on the project's scope, the type of tile, and the condition of the subfloor. A small bathroom might take 1-2 days, while a large multi-room project could span a week or more. Preparation, such as subfloor leveling or old flooring removal, can add considerable time. For example, if the existing subfloor in your Berkeley property needs extensive repairs or leveling, this will extend the overall timeline. Hometelligent Inc. provides a detailed project timeline upfront, including all preparation and curing times.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tile installation time varies by project size and subfloor condition, from 1-2 days for a small bathroom to over a week for larger projects.
